other_new_defects.quote: workflow's path holds a generated package id, so the worker uses the one new package directory under `.dev/tasks/to-do/` that its run created
other_new_defects.what_goes_wrong: With two parallel workflow workers in one worktree (or any other new package in that directory) 'the one new package directory' is ambiguous, so a worker can report another worker's contract path and the coordinator reads the wrong status.
